wedo_instance.description: Low-Token Hybrid HTML + JSON Weekly Sync Protocol for LexClinic Socratic Events (/event/YYYY-MM-DD/) and 101 Courseware Modules (/101/X.Y/). Eliminates O(N^2) context bloat and template drift while preserving rich LLM semantic HTML authoring.

meta.target_turn_budget: 8-12 tool calls max (~$3-$5 total session cost)

token_efficiency_rules.rule_1_never_hand_write_full_html_shells: NEVER call write_file to emit 400-600 line HTML shells for /event/YYYY-MM-DD/index.html, /101/X.Y/index.html, or /101/X.Y/quiz-*/index.html. Author ONLY the compact JSON spec (with rich semantic HTML slots) in chronos_repsl/specs/ and run `python3 chronos_repsl/scripts/weekly_sync_scaffold.py`.
token_efficiency_rules.rule_2_llm_authored_html_slots: Perform bespoke semantic HTML generation inside the spec's HTML slots (`hero_subtitle_html`, `overview_html`, `takeaways` / `takeaways_html`, `custom_sections_html`, `hub_card_summary_html`) or external fragment files (`overview_html_file`, `custom_sections_html_file`).
token_efficiency_rules.rule_3_never_read_full_hub_or_quiz_files: NEVER read full 540-line quiz files or 1,100-line /101/idea/index.html files into context. Use `grep_search` with `context: 5` or `read_file` with narrow 40-line `start_line`/`end_line` windows when inspecting hub insertion points.
token_efficiency_rules.rule_4_single_source_of_truth_quizzes: Author the 20 transcript-grounded Socratic questions ONCE in `chronos_repsl/specs/module_101_<X.Y>.json`. The compiler automatically generates `/101/<X.Y>/quiz-learned/index.html` (Q1-Q5), `/101/<X.Y>/quiz-expert/index.html` (Q1-Q20), and `/101/<X.Y>/quiz.html` (Smart Stage 1 + Stage 2) with 100% parity.

tasks.description: Media & Transcript Discovery: Fetch the new Socratic event GDrive folder / YouTube clip IDs and 101 YouTube/Spotify IDs. Transcribe audio with faster-whisper tiny.en (`audio.m4a` faststart in `/event/YYYY-MM-DD/audio.m4a`), run `py/substrate/transcript_strike.py` for forensic transcript cleanup, and append entries to `transcripts.json`.

Author Socratic Event Spec (`chronos_repsl/specs/event_<YYYY-MM-DD>.json`): Copy `chronos_repsl/specs/event_2026-11-05.json`, author bespoke semantic HTML for `hero_subtitle_html`, `overview_html`, and the 4-tile `takeaways_html` (or `takeaways` list), populate `audio_slug`, `audio_title`, and `clips[]`, and run `python3 chronos_repsl/scripts/weekly_sync_scaffold.py --compile-event chronos_repsl/specs/event_<YYYY-MM-DD>.json`.

Author 101 Module Spec (`chronos_repsl/specs/module_101_<X.Y>.json`): Copy `chronos_repsl/specs/module_101_7.1.json`, author unique `hero_subtitle_html`, `overview_html`, `hub_card_summary_html`, and 20 transcript-grounded questions (`questions`), then run `python3 chronos_repsl/scripts/weekly_sync_scaffold.py --compile-101 chronos_repsl/specs/module_101_<X.Y>.json --update-hub`.

Surgical Hub & Idea Map Updates: Using narrow line-range `read_file` + `replace`, rotate `/event/index.html` (Upcoming + Top-3 Recent + Monthly Archive count), insert the event card into `/event/<YYYY-MM>/index.html`, update `/101/idea/index.html` (strictly 101 lecture concepts—no Socratic audit boxes, all tables wrapped in `.idea-table-wrap` / `.idea-table`), and register new IDs in Linter Rules 04, 05, and 07.

Contract Verification & Staging Push: Verify `git status` shows zero out-of-scope files (e.g. `/nft/`) and zero tracked media binaries, run `node kairos_repsl/website/.linter/runner.js && node kairos_repsl/website/.tests/runner.js`, and push via `chronos_repsl/scripts/repsl_dual_commit.py`.
